_note: ENTRY SURFACE is where a person starts. DISPATCHER is selected once per run. A requested dispatch-capable provider wins while its verified route and backing usage are usable; otherwise the resolver selects the best usable configured fallback. Different users select profiles or pass --intake-provider without rewriting global policy. Exactly one effective dispatcher exists per run, never one absolute dispatcher for every user and every run.

dispatcher.rule: Honor the requested or profile-preferred dispatcher if it is configured, evidence-qualified, live, and usable. A valid but unavailable provider falls through automatically. A known non-dispatch intake relays without gaining authority. Unknown identities and malformed dispatch claims fail closed.

default.note: Reference preference only. Each user or integration may add a profile or pass --intake-provider per run.

claude-code.note: User-selected Claude model may dispatch. Selection is per run; availability fallback is automatic.

codex-cli.note: User-selected Sol, Terra, or Luna may dispatch. Reviewer choice then excludes authors and independently checks dispatch intent.

grok-cli.note: Grok may dispatch. Implementation prefers another usable coding seat first, then Grok as a last in-family option.

cursor.note: Cursor model identity is not a tested dispatch route. It may prepare an ordinary brief for the per-run dispatcher.

rules.entry_is_free: Any configured surface may start work. Provider/profile selection and live usage determine the one effective dispatcher for that run.
